notes: Sourced from the official Extreme Networks X440-G2 series datasheet (ExtremeSwitching X440-G2, doc 10450-0921-08). The X440-G2-12p-10GE4 (Part # 16531) is a 1RU edge switch: 12x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ-45 with PoE+ (802.3at, also 802.3af-compatible), 4x unpopulated 1GBASE-X SFP slots on the front panel (upgradeable to 10GbE SFP+ via a paid software license — datasheet lists this model's "Maximum 10Gb SFP+ Ports" as "4 via license", so grade shown here reflects shipped/default 1G state, not the licensed 10G capability), 1x RJ-45 serial console with RTS/CTS, 1x RJ-45 out-of-band 10/100/1000 management port, and a 2x7 terminal-block RPS port for an optional external redundant power supply (no single listed connector id matches a bare terminal block; "euroblock" was chosen as the closest analog — treat with caution). Internal power supply is fixed AC, IEC 320 C14 inlet / C13 cord (100-240VAC). No DC variant exists for this exact 12p model (a DC-only variant exists for the 24t/48t models, not for 12p). PoE budget is 200W total, with an external RPS able to provide an additional 200W for full PoE+ redundancy. Rack width/depth is 12.01 in x 10.28 in (narrower "half-width"-style 1RU chassis typical of 12-port X440-G2 models) — included rackUnits=1 since it's a formal 1RU rack-mount unit per the datasheet's Physical table, though it is narrower than full 19" width.

ports.name: Ports 1-12 (10/100/1000BASE-T PoE+)
ports.note: 12x RJ-45, IEEE 802.3at PoE+ (also supports 802.3af); 200W total PoE power budget

ports.name: SFP 13-16 (1GBASE-X, upgradeable to 10GbE)
ports.note: 4x unpopulated front-panel 1GBASE-X SFP slots; upgradeable to 10Gb SFP+ via separate software license (part 16542/16543), not enabled by default on this SKU

ports.name: Console
ports.note: RS-232 serial console port over RJ-45 with RTS/CTS modem control; not a data-networking Ethernet port

ports.name: RPS
ports.note: 2x7 terminal-block port for connecting an external redundant power supply (e.g. STK-RPS-150PS); closest connector match to a terminal-block/pluggable-screw connector, not a true Euroblock but nearest listed id

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: Fixed internal AC power supply; IEC 320 C14 inlet, IEC 320 C13 power cord plug, 100-240VAC 50/60Hz
